result.title: Towards a GraphNARX model for structural dynamics
result.summary: The current paper introduces the GraphNARX model, a graph-based nonlinear autoregressive exogenous model for structural dynamics. The model is built to account for the geometry of structures and to model dynamic behaviour as the interaction between elements of the structure. Similar to other types of NARX models, GraphNARX is used for system identification. Nodal attributes of the graph encode past displacements and nodal forces, and the output of the model is the next-timestep displacement. The graph formulation of the model allows it to generalise to structures of different dimensions and degrees of freedom. Moreover, because graph-learning is performed locally between the nodes, the GraphNARX model can also learn to infer displacements of nodes for which data are not available, i.e.\ to perform virtual sensing. The proposed model's performance is evaluated in a system-identification framework and a virtual-sensing framework, and achieves good accuracy and exhibits generalisation capabilities to structures of different sizes.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 GraphNARX——一种基于图的非线性自回归外生模型，用节点属性编码历史位移与节点力，输出下一时刻位移，在系统辨识与虚拟传感（推断无数据节点位移）两个任务上验证了精度与向不同尺寸结构的泛化能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以「历史位移＋外力」构成状态并由局部节点交互递推，可能与 LVR 中状态更新与推理步进的组织方式有可比之处；「虚拟传感」推断缺失节点位移的设定，可供核查其是否类比于从潜状态补全未观测的视觉证据，以及向不同自由度结构的泛化是否类比于长度/规模泛化。以上均为远领域推测，需阅读原文确认。
